meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax differentiation)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and French civil law heritage, with customary law formally recognized under the Constitution of Vanuatu)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public and competent national authority in the country of residence of the UBO

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each disclosed ultimate beneficial owner, with notarial attestation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN lists, EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, HM Treasury sanctions list, and the Vanuatu FIU domestic watchlist. Politically exposed persons (foreign and domestic PEPs), their family members, and close associates are subject to enhanced due diligence under FATF Recommendation 12, with source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification and escalation to the registered agent's Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO). Adverse hits mandate immediate Suspicious Transaction Reporting to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 181].

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Office Integrated Registry Online Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The primary registered name of an International Company must be expressed in Latin script using the English or French alphabet, reflecting Vanuatu's two official languages. Names in non-Latin scripts require an approved phonetic transliteration that is reserved as the definitive registered name; all statutory registers and certificates issue in the Latin-script form. The name must end with a recognized corporate suffix such as Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, or Société Anonyme.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Where a proposed name is rejected, the applicant or its licensed registered agent must file a written representation to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the refusal notice, particularizing grounds of non-deception, non-conflict with existing registrations, and compliance with the International Companies Act 2022. If the Registrar maintains the refusal, the applicant may appeal to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 21 days from the final refusal notice. A fresh name reservation may be submitted concurrently without prejudice to the administrative appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a sole statutory address: the International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the address of a licensed registered agent. For the proposed patent prosecution agency, back-office operations may be conducted fully virtually outside Vanuatu, provided that physical corporate records are accessible at the registered office and the agent is able to present statutory records on demand.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspections: approximately 15–25% annual probability for a standard non-licensed International Company acting as an IP filing agency. If the entity opts to obtain a VFSC professional-services license, the risk rises materially to approximately 40–50% annually under VFSC risk-based supervision protocols.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 33 of 1992), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014 and the Companies (Amendment) Act 2021 — ss. 5 (registration), 11 (registered office), 12 (registered agent) and 15–17 (memorandum and articles).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Section
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 — Application for Registration of an International Company, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed by the International Companies Act; share capital may be denominated in any currency and no escrow or deposit account requirement applies to an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the allotment and issuance of shares to the founding subscriber be and is hereby ratified and confirmed. RESOLVED that the registered office address of the Company in Vanuatu, as notified to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, be and is hereby adopted as the statutory registered office, and the resident agent is authorized to maintain statutory records thereat. RESOLVED that [Director] be appointed as Sole Director and Company Secretary, and [Resident Agent] as Administrator, each empowered to open banking accounts, execute agreements, and make regulatory filings. RESOLVED that the directors be authorized to secure all operating licenses and carry on the business of intellectual property prosecution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission — Online Name Clearance Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name and two alternative names through a VFSC-licensed registered agent via the online portal. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, and must not contain restricted words such as 'trust', 'bank', 'insurance' or 'assurance' without a separate licence. Upon approval, the name is reserved for a period of twenty-eight days.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 Name Clearance Application
Three proposed company names in ranked order
Certified passport copies of directors and shareholders
Written instruction from the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused, file a fresh clearance application with alternative names; the registered agent may challenge the refusal by written representation to the VFSC Registry within 14 days. Any rejection fee is waived upon subsequent successful reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of VFSC Licensed Registered Agent and Appointment of Resident Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (private statutory office holder registered under s. 12 of the International Companies Act)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a client engagement agreement with a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila. The agent performs statutory know-your-client due diligence on the beneficial owner, directors and secretary, and prepares the statutory registers. The registered agent is mandatory for an International Company and maintains the Register of Directors and Register of Members at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Executed registered agent engagement letter
Certified passport copy and proof of residential address of each beneficial owner
Original bank reference letter issued within the last 6 months
Brief curriculum vitae of the proposed director and secretary
Consent to act as director, secretary and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent queries the KYC documentation, supply a notarized source-of-funds declaration or an independent professional reference within 5 business days; if the agent declines engagement, the company may appoint another VFSC-licensed agent without loss of the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Republic of Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, reflecting the objects clause limited to ISIC 7490 activities: PCT patent prosecution, international trademark registration and ancillary intellectual property services. The document must be executed by each subscriber in the presence of a Vanuatu notary public or, if executed abroad, authenticated by a Vanuatu consular officer or apostille under the Hague Convention.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (original signed version)
Notarial or apostilled certificate of execution
Subscriber consent and initial share subscription declaration
Consent to act of each director and the secretary
Registered agent certificate confirming acceptance of duties under s. 12
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If execution is defective, re-execute the memorandum and articles before a Vanuatu notary or obtain an apostille from the issuing authority of the subscriber's jurisdiction within 10 days; amended pages may be re-filed without restarting the registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission to VFSC, Payment of Incorporation Fee and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Companies Registry — Physical counter at Rue Pasteur, Port Vila, or via approved online filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the registration package with the Companies Registry together with the government fee. The Registrar examines the documents for compliance with the International Companies Act and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the date of registration and the company number. Upon incorporation, the company is required to register its particulars with the VFSC within 30 days.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 — Application for Registration of an International Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association (final executed original)
Certificate of Registered Agent under s. 12 of the International Companies Act
Form IC-2 — Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent
Proof of payment of the USD 350 (VUV 40,000) VFSC incorporation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a compliance query, respond in writing within 14 days correcting names, objects or capital provisions and pay any additional filing fee; if the Certificate is refused, appeal to the Minister responsible for financial services under the Act or re-file a corrected application without penalty within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Formalities: First Board Resolution, Municipal Business Licence and Occupational Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Port Vila or Luganville Municipal Council Business Licence Unit; Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services; Department of Labour
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the statutory first board meeting to adopt the pro-forma resolutions, approve the subscription of shares, and formalize the appointment of officers. Apply for the Municipal Business Licence under the Municipalities Act [Cap. 126] covering 'Professional, Scientific and Technical Activities' (ISIC 7490). Obtain fire safety certification and workplace registration before commencing operations, then open bank operating accounts at a licensed Vanuatu bank or offshore correspondent bank.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and registered agent certificate
First Board Resolutions (minutes) reflecting share subscription, registered office adoption and officer appointments
Municipal Business Licence application form with premises lease agreement
Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services inspection certificate
Department of Labour workplace registration form
Director identification and bank account opening pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal council delays the business licence, commence operations under a provisional receipt issued upon application, provided the application is complete; if fire certification fails, remedy identified deficiencies and re-inspect within 10 business days; if the Department of Labour queries workplace registration, submit the amended health-and-safety statement within 7 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for professional services integrity; Port Vila/Luganville Municipal Council Business Licence Unit for local operational authorization
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Business Licence (ISIC 7490 — Professional, Scientific and Technical Activities) under the Municipalities Act [Cap. 126]; patent matters are prosecuted before WIPO international registry and designated national offices, with no separate Vanuatu patent-agent licence requirement

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change and Natural Resources, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categorised as Exempt/Low Impact under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2011 (Schedules 1–3); office-based professional services with no prescribed industrial activity — a full EIA is not required; DEPC may issue an Environmental Registration Certificate if any premises alteration exceeds minor works thresholds
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source industrial discharges triggered; office wastewater is domestic-strength and connected to municipal sewerage (no VOC, NOx or particulate thresholds apply); obsolete confidential records must be disposed of in compliance with the Waste Management Act No. 15 of 2018; any e-waste export must comply with Basel Convention transboundary movement provisions

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services (VFES) for the registered office premises; building occupancy and structural load clearance from the Port Vila Municipal Council Plan Approval Unit; workplace registration with the Department of Labour under the Employment Act [Cap. 160]; workers' compensation enrolment under the Workers' Compensation Act [Cap. 175]; a business continuity plan addressing tropical cyclone risk and seismic safety is recommended for civil-defense compliance

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) - Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; e-filing portal: Vanuatu Revenue Management System (VAT and TIN administration); International Company licensing: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu national taxes, so no income-tax TIN is required; the IC obtains a VFSC registration number and Certificate of Incorporation through a licensed registered agent. For VAT purposes, an IC that wishes to claim input credits or issue zero-rated invoices must procure a TIN or VAT registration number from VRC by filing the VAT registration form, attaching the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, registered-agent due-diligence confirmation, local address or bank details, and anticipated turnover declaration; non-resident shareholders may complete the process by power of attorney through the VFSC-registered agent, with no physical presence in Vanuatu required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or analogous regime exists in Vanuatu; therefore no check-the-box election is available or required, and hybrid mismatch elections are inapplicable. ICs are automatically tax-exempt under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and, where invoked, may obtain a further tax-exemption certificate under the Vanuatu Economic Development Act. An IC may voluntarily elect VAT registration under the VAT Act [Cap 248]; compulsory registration arises only upon crossing the VT 5,000,000 taxable-supplies threshold.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (five million vatu) of taxable supplies in any 12-month period; voluntary registration available; exports of goods and supplies of services to non-residents are zero-rated
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or mandatory electronic-invoicing clearance regime applies in Vanuatu. Registered persons must issue tax invoices under Section 24 of the VAT Act [Cap 248] showing the supplier name, TIN or VAT number, invoice date, description of supply, VAT amount, and total; VAT returns are filed electronically through the VRC Revenue Management System, and goods customs declarations are lodged through the ASYCUDA World system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports qualify for the 0% VAT rate under Section 6 of the VAT Act [Cap 248] where goods are physically exported from Vanuatu within the prescribed period or services are supplied to, and wholly enjoyed by, a non-resident outside Vanuatu. Patent-prosecution and international-trademark agency services delivered to overseas clients qualify as zero-rated exported services provided the IC maintains signed service contracts, invoices non-resident counterparties in foreign currency, performs no supply to Vanuatu residents, and retains sufficient evidence that the service was rendered outside the Vanuatu domestic market.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged in ASYCUDA World (goods exports only)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical removal from Vanuatu (goods exports only)
Commercial invoice and signed service contract or engagement letter naming the non-resident client
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT or MT103 credit evidence proving fees were paid from offshore funds
VAT zero-rated schedule and tax-invoice register substantiating each export claim
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline; the 180-day convention is applied by banks and auditors as the evidentiary benchmark for inward receipts supporting export zero-rating. Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating claims expose the IC to VAT reassessment, statutory interest, late-payment penalties of up to 25% of the tax due, and criminal fines for false documentation under the VAT Act; confirmed dealing with Vanuatu residents additionally breaches the International Companies Act, triggering VFSC strike-off, director disqualification, and registered-agent licence consequences, with retrospective clawback of input credits and zero-rating relief for the statutory limitation period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalized exchange control regime administered by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu. The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is convertible for both current-account and capital-account transactions, with no general prohibitions on foreign-currency accounts held by residents or non-resident entities. Profit remittance, dividend distribution, and capital repatriation from an International Company may be effected freely through authorized banks without prior central bank approval, subject to submission of standard documentary evidence (e.g., audited financial statements, board resolution, tax clearance where applicable). The regime creates no material bottleneck for patent prosecution fee flows, as service-related current payments and operational disbursements are outside administered surrender requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory obligation to surrender export receipts or service revenue in foreign currency to the central bank. Exporters and service providers, including intellectual property prosecution agencies, may retain receivables in foreign currency accounts with licensed domestic banks. The only compliance condition is that foreign-currency earnings from exports or cross-border services must be declared through the banking channel on the relevant inward remittance form, and documentary support (invoice, contract, or POA) must be retained for bank verification. There is no mandatory conversion ratio to VUV.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and USD Multi-Currency Account
Foreign Currency Operational Account and Escrow Account
Operational VUV and Foreign Currency Account
Corporate Operational Account and Trade Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium with legal constraints. Offshore digital EMI platforms such as Wise, Payoneer, or Airwallex can be used as supplementary payment rails for low-value, non-escalatory disbursements (e.g., annuities, small filing fees), but they are not licensed as banks or deposit-taking institutions in Vanuatu. They cannot lawfully provide the full fiduciary escrow or account-holding function required for capital injection escrow or large outbound transfers. Their use is restricted to the 'target_payment_rails' category of fintech conduits, and any use must be backed by a domestic bank account for ultimate settlement. Legal constraints include the Financial Dealers Act and the International Companies Act prohibition on conducting banking business without an RBV license, the inability of an EMI to issue SWIFT-based legal payment undertakings, and exposure to de-risking if funds flow to high-risk patent office jurisdictions without an underlying invoice trail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical director presence is not an absolute statutory mandate. Domestic commercial banks generally permit remote account opening for International Companies once the full corporate due-diligence pack is submitted, provided that each director and signatory completes a video KYC interview with an account manager. The interview must be conducted in real time, recorded, and archived. In practice, at least one director or authorized signatory must be available for an in-person meeting at the bank's Port Vila branch if the beneficial ownership structure appears complex or if the application is for a segregated escrow account. Remote opening is available for clean, low-risk patent prosecution structures with transparent ultimate beneficial ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity: nominee shareholders or unregistered ownership layers above the International Company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficial ownership register or statutory declaration; full chain of ownership from ultimate natural persons to the IC; registered agent confirmation under the International Companies Act; certified passport copies; proof of physical residential address for all ultimate beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payments to patent offices or IP jurisdictions perceived as high-risk or sanctions-affected
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed narrative of the patent prosecution service; client engagement agreement; correspondences and invoices from WIPO or national patent offices; official filing receipts; breakdown of official fees vs. service fees; originator and beneficiary identification for each payment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexpected remittance patterns: fast movement of funds through multiple foreign-currency accounts without economic correspondence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury policy and forecast; board resolution authorizing an international fee-settlement schedule; underlying patent/prosecution contracts; evidence of the waterfall from client-funded retainers to official fee disbursement; matching invoices and actual patent filings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP screening hits on foreign patent attorneys, corporate clients, or jurisdictions of filing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions exposure analysis; PEP or adverse-media screening results; legal justification of the business relationship; client representation letter; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation; customs of the patent prosecution industry demonstrating arm's-length fee flows.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections to fund the Vanuatu International Company's operational escrow and disbursement accounts must be routed through a licensed RBV-authorized commercial bank using SWIFT MT103 or equivalent wire transfers. The sender must provide the Vanuatu receiving bank with the remitter's identity, source-of-funds documentation (shareholder loan agreement, equity subscription agreement, or client retainer), and the relevant purpose code for the transaction. For capital subscriptions, the purpose code 'S001 – Establishment of a foreign-invested enterprise' or 'S010 – Equity capital contribution' is used, while for pre-payments for patent prosecution services the code 'S020 – Service transaction payment' applies. The receiving bank performs a verification of the remitter's KYC profile, the matching of the beneficiary name to the IC's board resolution, and confirmation that the transaction does not violate the sanctions list. Upon receipt, the funds are held in an operational or escrow account segregated from any proprietary balances, with the correspondent relationship routed through ANZ or BSP's offshore banking groups (e.g., ANZ Australia, BSP Papua New Guinea, or a New York/London correspondent) for USD clearing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for patent prosecution fees, PCT filing costs, and international trademark registrations are executed primarily through SWIFT MT103 payments from the IC's foreign-currency account at an RBV-licensed bank to official patent offices, law firms, or annuities service providers. The payment instruction must include a precise beneficiary description, the invoice or reference number of the official fee, and a purpose code reflecting 'royalties or service fees' as appropriate. Commercial Letters of Credit (LCs) are not a standard clearing rail for IP service disbursements and are generally not advisable; the prevailing global protocol is direct MT103 wire settlement with a full audit trail. Same-day value is achievable for patent office payments in the United States and Europe using the US or EU correspondent clearing networks, while PCT fee payments to WIPO may be settled via the MT103 to the Bank for International Settlements or approved commercial banks. Acceptable supporting documentation for outbound wire release includes the patent filing scoreboard, the client billing ledger, the official fee schedule, and the registered agent's fee note.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu Vatu / USD delivered forward contract permitted through an authorized dealer bank (limited under normal market circumstances, requiring a substantive exposure correspondence)
Vanuatu Vatu / AUD delivered forward or spot-hedged via an authorized dealer where currency risk is recognized
USD-denominated cost-management through natural hedge by maintaining all patent-office disbursements in USD or EUR, reducing the need for forwards

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts on VUV or adjacent Pacific currencies executed through a non-resident investment bank with a corresponding Vanuatu-beneficiary settlement account, subject to board approval and compliance documentation

Cross-currency swap with a licensed domestic or offshore bank for converting a long-term VUV liability into USD floating-rate exposure, available only to the IC with a board-adopted foreign-exchange risk-management mandate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of an International Company (prescribed form lodged by the Licensed Registered Agent covering name, registered office, registered agent, authorized capital, issued shares, directors and shareholders)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month (30 days) after each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty accrues on overdue annual fees; continued non-payment or non-filing triggers a VFSC notice of intention to strike off under Section 138 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; administrative dissolution follows if the default is not cured within the prescribed notice period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Register confirmation and registered-agent KYC update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Beneficial Ownership Register maintained by the Licensed Registered Agent and producible on demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ongoing obligation; any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership must be recorded promptly and the register re-confirmed at the annual renewal cycle aligned with the Annual Return due date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty orders under the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) regime for failure to maintain an accurate UBO register or obstructing VFSC inspection; persistent non-compliance is reportable to the Registrar and may aggravate strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None — a standard Vanuatu International Company is exempt from statutory audit and from filing audited financial statements with the VFSC regardless of revenue, asset or headcount thresholds. Compulsory audit applies only where the IC holds a regulated Financial Dealers License or other VFSC Act license, or where its articles of association voluntarily impose an audit requirement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB is the applicable reporting framework for Vanuatu International Companies; however, no framework-based statutory financial statements are required to be filed with the VFSC for a standard tax-exempt International Company.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every International Company must hold a Beneficial Ownership Register at the office of its Licensed Registered Agent in Vanuatu. Shareholders must notify the registered agent of any share transfer or change in beneficial control and the UBO register must be updated before the anniversary renewal is certified. The register is not filed at the VFSC registry but must be produced immediately on written demand; the registered agent performs an annual KYC re-verification of all ultimate beneficial owners concurrent with the Annual Return cycle.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Directors' and Shareholders' Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – USD 1,500 per annum (market rate for licensed Vanuatu registered agent, registered office, nominee director and compliance administration)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable for a standard exempt International Company; if a voluntary audit is commissioned, Port Vila market rates typically range USD 2,500 – USD 6,000 per engagement.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate. Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, interest withholding tax, royalty withholding tax, or stamp duty on International Companies (ICs). The IC is structurally tax-exempt under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222), and patent prosecution and trademark registration fees earned by the agency from non-resident clients are outside the Vanuatu direct tax net. The exemption is conditional on maintaining a VFSC-licensed registered agent, paying annual VFSC fees, and satisfying the Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) if a relevant activity is carried on.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is levied or required. The mandatory annual compliance filing is the VFSC International Company Annual Return (Form ICAR), submitted online through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The ICAR must be filed within one calendar month after the anniversary of incorporation. There are no quarterly estimated tax payment requirements or fiscal-year-end corporate tax return deadlines because the IC has zero taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the International Company and VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use only the name and number shown on the Certificate of Incorporation. Non-resident owners must not operate under a non-registered trade name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address and name, address, and license number of the Vanuatu-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be a physical address in Vanuatu maintained by the registered agent; P.O. boxes alone are not accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Details of issued share capital, classes of shares, and beneficial shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all ultimate beneficial owners by full legal name, nationality, date of birth, residential address, and percentage of ownership. Nominee disclosure alone is not sufficient under AML rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, company secretary, and principal business activity, including the ISIC/NAICS classification and proof of any professional or statutory patent agency license.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The director list must match the VFSC register. For non-resident directors, attach a certified copy of the director's passport and a statement of non-resident status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of tax-exempt status and economic substance. The registered agent confirms whether the IC is a pure holding company, a service company, or a relevant activity company under ESR 2019.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a patent prosecution agency, if the income is derived from professional service fees and no patent/trademark royalties are received, declare as a service business. If the IC owns, licenses, or otherwise monetizes IP, declare as an IP business and provide ESR particulars.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the ICAR or late payment of the VFSC annual fee triggers monetary penalties of up to VUV 500,000, daily default surcharges, automatic interest accruals, suspension of the IC's certificate, strike-off from the register, and forfeiture of assets held by the company in Vanuatu. The registered agent may also be disqualified from acting as a licensed agent.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreements. For any limited treaty-like relief or for foreign tax credit support, the non-resident shareholder must submit a written request to the VFSC and the Ministry of Finance for a Certificate of Tax Status / Tax Residency Certificate, together with the ICAR, audited financial statements if requested, a board resolution resolving to declare the dividend, and a formal declaration that the IC has no Vanuatu-source income. Because no DTA network exists, treaty relief cannot be claimed inside Vanuatu; the foreign shareholder must instead rely on the home-country unilateral foreign tax credit mechanism, supported by the Vanuatu tax status certificate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for both cross-border royalties and debt interest. Patent/trademark royalties paid by the Vanuatu IC to a non-resident licensing party are not subject to Vanuatu withholding tax. Interest on shareholder loans is similarly exempt from Vanuatu tax. No treaty reductions are needed since the domestic rate is already zero; foreign counterparties must still consider source-country withholding and gross-up obligations outside Vanuatu.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VUV 0 (no corporate income tax and therefore no Local File or Master File transfer pricing compliance threshold in Vanuatu). ESR recordkeeping obligations may apply irrespective of revenue where an IC carries on a relevant activity; the VFSC may request financial statements, invoices, bank records, and payroll records on a risk-factored basis.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Under Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2019, every International Company that carries on a relevant activity must demonstrate adequate economic substance in Vanuatu. A patent prosecution agency is ordinarily classified as carrying on a 'service business' if it earns fee income for PCT patent prosecution and trademark registration services; such an entity must maintain a physical office in Vanuatu, full-time qualified employees, proportionate operating expenditures, and board meetings held and minuted in Vanuatu. If the same IC holds, licenses, or otherwise administers patent/trademark intellectual property and receives royalty-style income, it is classified as an IP business and is subject to a more stringent substance test requiring demonstrable decision-making and development activity in Vanuatu. Pure equity holding entities enjoy lighter obligations but must still file an ESR return and maintain a registered office and records.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Abusive Tax Arrangement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to invoice patent prosecution fees or royalties for economic activities actually performed in a high-tax country, while maintaining no real management presence, staff, or operational substance in Vanuatu, with the intent of evading foreign corporate income tax or concealing the true beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2020, as amended, and the Proceeds of Crime Act; the VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit may impose corporate fines up to VUV 20,000,000, seize illicit proceeds, strike the company off, and report the arrangement to foreign tax authorities under a Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced on grounds of fraud; directors and beneficial owners are personally liable for civil restitution of diverted income, are subject to court-ordered asset freezes and travel bans, and may face imprisonment for money-laundering offences of up to 15 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a zero-substance shell, with no Vanuatu office, no payroll, no bank activity, no board meeting records, and no commercial records evidencing patent prosecution or trademark services, while claiming the full IC tax exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019 and the International Companies Act (Cap. 222); the VFSC may impose penalties up to VUV 5,000,000, issue a non-compliance direction, strike the company off, and notify the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false economic substance declarations are personally liable for penalties and restitution of illegal distributions; courts may issue travel bans and disqualification orders; imprisonment of up to 10 years may be imposed if fraudulent misrepresentation is established.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting retainer payments for PCT patent filing or trademark prosecution without performing customer due diligence, processing client funds through third-party or personal accounts, concealing sanctioned or politically exposed persons, or providing false beneficial ownership data in the VFSC annual return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of the Vanuatu Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2020 and VFSC AML Code; corporate penalties reach VUV 25,000,000, with mandatory confiscation of funds; natural persons are liable to fines and imprisonment for up to 10 years; the IC may lose its exempt status and be struck off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, shareholders, and the registered agent are treated as culpable principals for AML offences; the corporate veil is pierced, requiring disgorgement of all fees; travel bans and asset confiscation orders may be issued pending criminal proceedings, and imprisonment can be extended to 15 years for aggravated laundering.
